en_title: Silent Hill Remake Coming 2027, First Cast Details Leaked
cn_title: 曝《寂静岭》重制版拟于2027年发售
subtitle: 首批演员信息流出
opus_summary: 据MP1ST爆料，《寂静岭》初代重制版自2022年起开发，目标于2027年发售。项目以「Project Noise」为代号选角，两名演员将出演重要角色，具体角色尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: With Silent Hill 2’s remake selling 6 million copies , it’s no surprise Bloober Team and Konami would want to have another crack at things. Last year, the Polish developer and Japanese publisher confirmed they were doing just that with a remake of the first Silent Hill .
paragraphs.cn: 《寂静岭2》重制版卖出了600万份，Bloober Team和科乐美想再重制一部作品，也就不足为奇了。去年，这家波兰开发商和日本发行商确认，双方将重制初代《寂静岭》。

paragraphs.en: The 1999 PS1 horror game is getting the Bloober treatment, and a new leak from MP1ST suggests work has been underway since 2022 and the game is targeting a 2027 launch.
paragraphs.cn: 这款1999年登陆PS1的恐怖游戏将由Bloober Team重制。据MP1ST最新爆料，重制工作自2022年起便已展开，目标于2027年发售。

paragraphs.en: According to the report, the game cast its actors under the codename “Project Noise,” and features Gabrielle Fritz and Jade Matthew in major roles.
paragraphs.cn: 报道称，这款游戏以「Project Noise」为代号开展选角，Gabrielle Fritz和Jade Matthew将出演重要角色。

paragraphs.en: Fritz has worked in other games, from Battlefield 2042 to Wolfenstein 2: The New Colossus, as well as a range of TV shows. Matthew is best known for British TV appearances.
paragraphs.cn: Fritz曾参与《战地风云2042》《德军总部2：新巨像》等游戏，也出演过多部电视剧。Matthew则主要因出演英国电视剧而为人所知。

paragraphs.en: While it isn’t clear what roles the two actors play in Silent Hill’s remake, the report speculated that police officer Cybil Bennett, nurse Lisa Garland, or primary antagonist Dahlia Gillespie would fit. There’s no word on who could play protagonist Harry Mason yet.
paragraphs.cn: 目前尚不清楚这两名演员会在《寂静岭》重制版中饰演谁，不过报道推测，警察Cybil Bennett、护士Lisa Garland或主要反派Dahlia Gillespie都可能是合适的角色。至于谁可能饰演主角哈里·梅森，目前还没有消息。

paragraphs.en: Bloober Team is also working on DLC for Cronos: The New Dawn, its multiplayer horror game, Saw: Genesis, and story-driven adventure Star Trek: Shadow Frontier.
paragraphs.cn: Bloober Team还在开发《时间旅者：重生曙光》的DLC、多人恐怖游戏《Saw: Genesis》，以及剧情驱动的冒险游戏《星际迷航：暗影边境》。

paragraphs.en: The 2027 release window lines up with Konami’s recent spate of Silent Hill projects, with Townfall launching this year and Silent Hill f in 2025, giving us a new Silent Hill project each year. You can check out the games in order in our Silent Hill timeline .
paragraphs.cn: 2027年的发售窗口也符合科乐美近期推出《寂静岭》系列项目的节奏：《Silent Hill: Townfall》将于今年发售，《寂静岭f》则在2025年推出，这样每年都会有一部新的《寂静岭》作品。

paragraphs.en: Konami is planning "second and third waves" of new Silent Hill games , according to producer Motoi Okamoto, who pointed at Silent Hill 2 Remake, Silent Hill f, and Silent Hill: Townfall as the first wave.
paragraphs.cn: 制作人冈本基表示，科乐美正在规划「第二波和第三波」《寂静岭》新游戏。他指出，《寂静岭 2 重制版》《寂静岭f》和《Silent Hill: Townfall》属于第一波。

paragraphs.en: That would make a remake of the first game the beginning of the second wave of new Silent Hill projects. It’ll be interesting to see what comes after.
paragraphs.cn: 如此一来，初代重制版就将成为第二波《寂静岭》新项目的开端。接下来还会有什么作品，值得关注。
